hooks.name: Keep documented rule patterns in sync
hooks.description: When the local rule compiler changes, check that the pattern table in README.md and the requirements still describe what the compiler accepts and refuses.

action.prompt: A rule compiler file changed. Compare PATTERN_DOCS in src/engine/rule-compiler and the supported-patterns table in README.md, and the rule types in .kiro/specs/gridfuzz/requirements.md (R2). If they disagree, update the README table and requirements to match the code. Do not change source code or tests. Report what you changed in one or two sentences, or say nothing needed changing.

hooks.name: Final gate before stopping
hooks.description: Typecheck and run the unit tests when the agent finishes a turn, so a turn never ends on a red build.
